## Objective
- Update the existing STARFALL game with three-segment health, improved controls, fewer asteroids, three-hit asteroid durability, and kill-point popups and rewards.

## Requirements
- Asteroid or UFO collision removes one health segment.
- Asteroids take three shots; award 50 points. UFOs award 20 points.
- Display points above each destroyed target.
- Improve controls and reduce asteroid frequency.

## Decisions
- Kept the existing auto-fire; holding Space or the touch fire button increases firing cadence.
- Added movement acceleration and damping for smoother keyboard and touch movement.
- Removed close-call score bonuses so the specified kill rewards are explicit.

## Work State

### Completed
- Updated `game.js` for three-hit asteroids, 50-point asteroid kills, 20-point UFO kills, floating point popups, fewer asteroids, collision damage, and smoothed movement.
- Updated `index.html` for segmented health-bar styling and clearer controls and reward guidance.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed.

### Active
- Review gameplay behavior and address any remaining issues.

### Blocked
- Browser check and requested screenshot were not completed: `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed because Chromium is not installed (`Browser "chromium" is not installed`).

## Next Move
1. Inspect and fix any gameplay issues in `game.js`, especially collision/bullet processing and popup rendering.
2. If available, install or locate Chromium, then launch the game, play-test, and save/read the latest screenshot.
3. Re-run syntax and diff checks.

## Relevant Files
- `game.js`: gameplay logic and requested changes.
- `index.html`: HUD, health bar, and player-facing controls/reward guidance.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted.
- A local HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The current `game.js` uses `registerKill(e, points, color)` and tracks asteroid hits in `userData.hits`.
